general_cs_errors.claim: Each driver can run CUDA programs up to a certain version, and no newer; the toolkit must not be newer than that limit.
general_cs_errors.problem: This is not an absolute upper limit. CUDA minor-version compatibility can allow programs built with a newer toolkit in the same major family to run on older drivers, subject to restrictions. Compatibility packages provide further supported cases. The game's stricter stacking rule is fine if labelled.
general_cs_errors.fix: The **driver** helps programs talk to the GPU. CUDA and driver versions must work together. (game version: a CUDA block cannot be newer than the driver's tag.)

general_cs_errors.claim: On Linux, the torch wheel brings the CUDA runtime and cuDNN inside.
general_cs_errors.problem: For the depicted modern Linux pip installation, CUDA libraries and cuDNN are separate dependency packages, not contents of the torch wheel. CPU-only builds also exist.
general_cs_errors.fix: `pip install torch` gets a **wheel**, a ready-made package. A CUDA-enabled Linux build also downloads GPU helper packages, including cuDNN. For ready-made GPU code, you usually just add the driver. (game version: we show one matching set.)

general_cs_errors.where: [pix] Easy route: let pip bring PyTorch with a CUDA that fits
general_cs_errors.claim: pip install torch automatically brings a CUDA version that fits the installed driver.
general_cs_errors.problem: pip resolves package requirements and platform compatibility; it does not select a CUDA build by checking the NVIDIA driver. An unpinned command also does not guarantee the depicted torch 2.6.0 installation.
general_cs_errors.fix: Easy route: we've picked a PyTorch package that fits this game computer. Type pip install torch.

general_cs_errors.claim: 81920 MiB equals 80 GB because 1024 MiB make 1 GB.
general_cs_errors.problem: 1024 MiB make 1 GiB, not 1 GB. 81920 MiB equals 80 GiB, approximately 85.9 decimal GB. The GPU's marketed “80GB” name does not change that unit conversion.
general_cs_errors.fix: Right! 81920 MiB = 80 GiB, because 1024 MiB make 1 GiB. This GPU's name says “80GB.”

general_cs_errors.fix: [y]apt can install Python packages too. For this game, use[/y] [w]pip[/w]
